scope: Observable states for one content replacement or new-file publication. Not a required runtime framework or a claim that any platform profile is verified.

states.meaning: Resolved immutable intent; target files unchanged.
Input/path/capability checks passed; required sources are identified for freezing and staging.
Complete candidate exists in a private staging artifact.
Candidate has passed required value, structure, preservation and property checks.
Candidate/recovery material and recovery record have required flush acknowledgements.
Publication intent was recorded; the namespace operation is in flight or its outcome may be unknown.
The target is observed to be the candidate; final durability/receipt work remains.
Installed output, required properties, durability acknowledgements and receipt are verified.
No requested effective change; no target rewrite or new backup.
A request/profile/capability policy prevents application; no publication by imageinfo.
An input/destination guard changed before publication; no publication by imageinfo.
Staging/validation/prepublication work failed; no publication by imageinfo.
Cancellation honored before publication; no publication by imageinfo.
The outcome or required guarantee is uncertain; preserve evidence and do not report success.
Recovery proves the original/expected-absent state; no automatic retry of the edit.

guards.request-valid: Whole-request syntax/intent is valid; any explicit continue policy has per-unit refusals recorded.
guards.explicit-apply: User requested application; a saved plan or imported metadata is not self-authorizing.
guards.inputs-current: Content, object/path identity and relevant properties match the plan or an explicitly proven earlier receipt.
guards.paths-bound: Resolved paths, parents, aliases and collision policy are bound to the supported profile.
guards.capability-evidenced: Exact format/variant/location/operation is enabled by evidence; untrusted records cannot grant this.
guards.profile-evidenced: Publication, concurrency, property and durability guarantees have a supported tested profile.
guards.no-effective-change: The requested representation/effect is already satisfied; no implicit canonicalization is needed.
guards.inputs-frozen: All copied values and referenced bytes needed by the unit are stable and verified.
guards.stage-complete: Staging finished without modifying the target or recompressing protected sensor data.
guards.values-valid: Typed intended changes and all implicit mandatory updates match the plan.
guards.preservation-valid: Protected sensor/preview/opaque content and required interpretation metadata are preserved.
guards.references-valid: Container lengths, offsets, references and checksums remain valid.
guards.properties-valid: The declared filesystem-property policy is satisfied.
guards.recovery-verified: Recoverable original bytes/properties or expected absence are established for this mode.
guards.record-flushed: Required current-phase transaction/ownership record persistence acknowledgements succeeded; an earlier-phase acknowledgement cannot be reused.
guards.publication-guard: Required source/destination exclusion or conditional operation remains effective across publication.
guards.candidate-current: The stage's content/identity has not changed since validation.
guards.installed-candidate: The installed target matches the staged identity/content under the profile.
guards.receipt-flushed: The final outcome/identities were recorded with required persistence.
guards.recovery-retained: Original recovery material still exists until successful-finalization retention policy is applied.
guards.original-current: Recovery proves the original identity/content/properties or expected absence.
guards.owned-record: Recovery artifacts/record belong to this transaction and pass integrity/path checks.
